notes.title: EXTRA! EXTRA! READ ALL ABOUT IT! News Tower's 1.0 Release Date Announced!
notes.content:
[h1]New York Prepares for Towering Takeover as Independent Publisher Rises to Power[/h1]
[h2]November 04, 2025 – New York City[/h2]

As the ink dries on the final editions of test print runs, all eyes are on an up-and-coming publication preparing to shake the very foundations of the newspaper world. News Tower, a newspaper tycoon management game set in the hustle and grit of 1930s New York, will officially launch on November 04, 2025, bringing players into the chaotic, colorful, and competitive heart of the city’s golden age of news.

[previewyoutube=dU2MZJadP40;full][/previewyoutube]

According to sources close to the press floor, the 1.0 version of News Tower will include a full suite of features designed to challenge, delight, and immerse aspiring tycoons in the fine art of publishing.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40684736/31ab2015128ce790699eca84eb06cce7b07381cd.png[/img]

[h2]FEATURES HEADLINED FOR RELEASE:[/h2]

[h3]🗞️ Live the Life of a 1930s Publisher[/h3]
Step into the polished shoes of a fresh-faced editor in 1930s NYC — build your paper, break the news, and rise through the ranks as you try to dominate the city’s information economy.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40684736/062bdc7a519bc7d1c13ef61b02bdfbb315f64512.jpg[/img]

[h3]🏙️ Compete for Control of the City[/h3]
Outmaneuver rival newspapers like The Jersey Beacon and Empire Observer in a strategic battle for district dominance. Watch your control over New York grow as you push your competitors out of strategic positions on the map to claim your newfound readership!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40684736/11d31c7cd7a738273ee4bcc29ada592ebcb342ac.jpg[/img]

[h3]🤝 Align with Powerful Factions[/h3]
Will you cozy up to the Mayor’s office, follow military orders, dine with High Society, or deal under the table with the Mafia? Each faction offers quests, bonuses, and political weight — but choose carefully. Favor with one may sour your relationship with another.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40684736/dce6c6c2b76c33c7cc74a1511c15f6f0cb80c0f5.jpg[/img]

[h3]🏢 Manage Your Tower from Top to Bottom[/h3]
From layout to logistics, manage every floor of your growing empire. Upgrade rooms, assign departments, and fine-tune your workflow from the first word to the final print.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40684736/035b6f5abe56ccb21177b17173821fa77995d753.jpg[/img]

[h3]🧠 Master the Newspaper Business[/h3]
Curate your stories, choose your editorial tone, and decide how sensational or serious your paper will be. Balance reputation, perception, and revenue as you chase the perfect front page.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40684736/3a4e31731855deef78b633aec508f3183e1fe8a0.jpg[/img]

[h3]😊 Take Care of Your Employees[/h3]
A happy employee makes for productive staff. From late-night deadlines to a clean workplace, your team’s well-being matters. Keep them motivated, rested, and ready to roll those presses.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40684736/ee1374bbc60baf5a4dc96fac2d8f7ccff9b4ba2c.jpg[/img]

[h3]🌍 Uncover stories from across the globe[/h3]
New York isn’t the only place making headlines. As your newsroom grows, so does your reach. Send reporters out into the world to chase leads, uncover hidden scandals, and bring back stories that will captivate your readers and define your legacy.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40684736/68c4823dc5079205f608322967bb476a2268da13.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40684736/77a068ee6a5ce6beb79403a42ca57c37e16abf6d.png[/img]

[h2]What’s Next?[/h2]

Between now and launch, we’ll be releasing more deep dives into 1.0’s biggest features, like the ones already done for competitors — such as a closer look at factions, and more. There’s still time to wishlist the game, jump into our community discussions, and prepare yourself to make your big debut onto the news scene.

Mark your calendars: November 04, 2025 — the battle for New York’s readership begins.

Thanks for being part of the journey. We wouldn’t be here without your support.

We've also got a sale on now, ending August 28. This is the last chance to take advantage of it before 1.0 launches in November. Additionally, due to us leaving Early Access in November with all of the new content and features coming with 1.0 we will be increasing the price from $19.99 to $24.99 with launch. Don't miss out on becoming the best news publisher of 1930s New York for the lowest price!

Don't forget to join us on Discord to talk with the community and devs about everything News Tower. We can't wait to see you there!

[url=https://discord.gg/WhxESt8CFp][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40684736/bc77014ebb42ab9982afbda9a400c0648c7f145d.png[/img][/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40684736/fcaafe7fe92f9b035798be4173b90f83391a1db8.png[/img]

– The News Tower Team

notes.title: The Road to 1.0 - Roadmap Update & 1.0 Content Reveal
notes.content: [p]Hey publishers![img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40684736/2bbebf9bce1a16bf9f68bbf234e5b3eb6a718e89.png"][/img][/p][p]We want to start this one off with a heartfelt [b]thank you to everyone who's supported[/b] [b]News Tower[/b]. Your excitement, feedback, and love for the game have meant everything to us. It's been amazing to see how many of you have built thriving newspaper empires, experimented with editorial styles, and filled New York with headlines. We're thrilled to see the community growing, and we’re even more excited about what’s just around the corner.[/p][p]We’re [b]getting closer to the full 1.0 release of News Tower[/b], and we’ve been working hard behind the scenes to make it the most newsworthy version of the game yet. And yes, a [b]community playtest[/b] [b]is coming soon, [/b]where you’ll get an early look at the new features![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40684736/bb00f4e96bad7c7e2952adebcd46b7c0338d2be2.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h1][b]Updated Development Roadmap[/b][/h1][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40684736/8a35e08bc7ec48c84c5bad819af1ccdecb470cde.jpg"][/img][/p][p]As we zero in on the finish line, we’ve made adjustments to the roadmap to help bring the 1.0 launch to you faster — and with even more content packed in.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]All future content is now 1.0-focused[/b][/h3][p]We've officially [b]wrapped up pre-launch updates[/b]. That means everything we’re working on from here out is [b]going straight into the 1.0 release[/b].[/p][p][/p][h3][b]No summer update[/b][/h3][p]We’ve decided to merge the summer update with the 1.0 release on the roadmap to keep our focus squarely on 1.0. But don’t worry — a [b]community playtest[/b] [b]will be arriving soon[/b] so we can gather your feedback and polish the new features together.[/p][p]The goal? A stronger, more feature-rich 1.0 — and a shorter wait to get there.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40684736/dd9fbbdecd9c22665a6ce481d84ada4af051123b.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h1][b]Sneak Peek at 1.0 Features[/b][/h1][p]Let’s take a quick look at a few of the big features arriving in the 1.0 release. We’ll be sharing more details on each one in future posts, but here’s a preview to whet your appetite:[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Competitor System[/b][/h3][p]You’re not the only paper in town anymore. In the [b]mid-to-late game, two rival newspapers will emerge[/b] on the readership map. If you clash in the same area, you’ll [b]trigger a district conflict[/b] — a [b]battle of popularity[/b] where only one paper comes out on top. Get ready to fight for your turf![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40684736/1905884d1e5e2a9d6e5ecf821d7aa0322cbc57e2.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3][b]Perception System[/b][/h3][p]Time to [b]define your editorial voice[/b]. Are you Informational, Moderate, or Sensational? Do you chase hard facts, balanced stories, or eye-grabbing headlines? Your editorial line will now shape how readers view your paper and unlock specific ways to gain extra sales. Choose wisely each week to match the needs of your audience or personal preference.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40684736/7b5ab3d9ac5153cc3294db63b6f0513e68aece67.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3][b]Faction System[/b][/h3][p]Factions are getting a major upgrade in 1.0. You’ll be dealing with [b]four key factions [/b]in New York: the Mafia, the Military, the Mayor, and High Society. Each faction includes [b]four NPCs[/b], each [b]with their own quests and agendas[/b]. Helping one might make enemies of another, so navigate carefully. Build your reputation, complete missions, and earn unique rewards for your newsroom. Each faction holds specific perks and trade-offs to ensure your choices have an impact on your gameplay.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40684736/27ef76c3d26f3d92a66087b2b7dacf59a17a21c1.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3][b]Leaderboards[/b][/h3][p]With the release of News Tower 1.0, we are also [b]implementing leaderboards[/b]. Compete against other news tycoons to see who can make the most out of their years in the business! You'll be able to [b]post and compare your scores against other players[/b], and we look forward to seeing who can get the best score after release. [/p][p][/p][h3][b]Endgame and New Towers[/b][/h3][p]We've [b]implemented two new towers[/b] that you'll be able to unlock through play. The [b]highrise and lowrise[/b]. One is a [b]tall, thin building[/b] that costs less per floor but requires very efficient use of space. The other is a [b]wide, short building[/b] that costs more per floor, but you get way more space to place your gear. Have fun creating your news empire in these two new news towers, coming with the release of 1.0.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40684736/1454894f4e0f2777b9f10a15a4c6cf0c61b20ff3.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Also what’s a good story without a strong ending? With 1.0, [b][i]News Tower[/i] will finally have a true conclusion[/b]. We won’t spoil it for you — you’ll have to uncover it yourself and find out what kind of publisher you have become. Keep publishing every Sunday, expand your influence, and maybe, just maybe, you’ll find out what that ending has in store.[/p][p]We'll not spoil this one with an image. You'll have to find out more on your own! [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40684736/6a8ff0c4eab8078b0585cb4bdaa1be8fd32220f6.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h1][b]What’s Next[/b][/h1][p]That’s just a taste of what’s coming — and we’ll be digging deeper into each of these systems in upcoming blogs.[/p][p]We can’t wait to get 1.0 into your hands, and the [b]upcoming community playtest[/b] is going to be a key part of that process. Keep your eyes on this space for announcements, sneak peeks, and more in-depth breakdowns of the new content. Be sure to [b]join our Discord[/b] server to participate when it begins![/p][p][/p][p][url="https://discord.gg/WhxESt8CFp"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40684736/bc77014ebb42ab9982afbda9a400c0648c7f145d.png"][/img][/url][/p][p][/p][p]As a quick summary of what's to come with the 1.0 release:[/p][list][*][p]Rival newspapers & district conflicts [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]New perception system [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Full faction questlines [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Narrative endgame [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Community playtest [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]and more...! [/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][/p][p]Thank you again for being part of the [i]News Tower[/i] journey. notes.content:
[h2]Hellooo Newsbearers of the world! 🐻[/h2]

With the Going International update out, we've been closely following your feedback and making adjustments to improve your newsroom experience. This patch brings a mix of improvements and bug fixes to ensure your global expansion runs smoothly! Along with more natural employee behavior and fine-tuned mechanics, we’ve also added Steam Cloud Saves, so your progress stays with you wherever you go. Let’s dive into the details!

[h2]🛠️ Improvements[/h2]

[list]
[*] Steam Cloud saves have been added. 
[*] Production employees now only help with the transportation of chain items that are supported by their assigned work station. 
[*] Added new Europe and Passive Desk traits to calendars throughout the game. 
[*] Tags on guides and quest pop-ups are now clickable, allowing you to sort the article side drawer. 
[*] The Popcorn Machine is now prestigious. 
[*] Floor construction prices have been lowered. 
[/list]

[h2]🐛 Bug Fixes[/h2]

[list]
[*] Fixed the “Above the Fold” quest requirement, which was displaying x2 instead of x3. It now correctly shows x3, in line with the front-page top slot.
[*] Fixed Travel Discounts that were not applying the correct 50% discount.
[*] Fixed a bug where the South American continent lock was visible for a split second when navigating between Europe and North America.
[*] Fixed a bug where some news items were prematurely removed from the globe before all potential story files were processed.
[*] Fixed an issue where the Hiring Board icon in the main HUD continued to display the exclamation mark for new applicants even after opening the Hiring Board.
[*] Fixed an issue where the soap bar could be placed on the wall on top of another object. 
[*] Fixed an issue in the newsbook where the employee tab overlapped the speech bubbles of assigned reporters.
[/list]

Thank you for your continued feedback and support! Your insights help shape News Tower, so keep those reports coming.

[i]Stay tuned for more breaking news![/i]

notes.title: Going International Update
notes.content:
Hello Newsbearers! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40684736/2bbebf9bce1a16bf9f68bbf234e5b3eb6a718e89.png[/img]

[h2]It's tiiime to expand overseas! [/h2]

The [b]Going International[/b] update is here. Your newsroom now has access to European headlines via the Telegrapher, letting you cover stories from across the Atlantic. 

And to speed up deliveries and make your tower run smoother than ever, we're also introducing the Pneumatic Tubes and the Dumbwaiters. Hopefully they help you keep up with the ever-growing demand for scoops! 

This update wouldn't be possible without our incredible community testers, who helped us refine the experience ahead of launch. In the patch notes below, we have highlighted the additions and changes that were a direct result of your input, so you can see how impactful your contribution truly is. Thank you so much for taking part in the testing. ❤

[previewyoutube=Ll2PiL4PY38;full][/previewyoutube]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40684736/77a068ee6a5ce6beb79403a42ca57c37e16abf6d.png[/img]

[h2]KEY ADDITIONS [/h2]

[h3]International News (Europe) [/h3]

Your tower now has the world at its fingertips! Europe has been introduced as a key region for international stories. To support this expansion, you can hire a dedicated telegrapher to relay news from across the continent with precision.  
Additionally, new traits have been added to your employee roster, enhancing their ability to tackle the challenges of international journalism. 

[h3]Dumbwaiter [/h3]

The dumbwaiter optimises resource management by facilitating the seamless transfer of coal, paper, food, and more between floors. By strategically selecting the floors where they are installed and ensuring a sufficient number of resuppliers, heavy crates can move from the pavement to their destination in no time!

[h3]Pneumatic Tubes [/h3]

This high-speed transport solution ensures reports and other production items can move swiftly between floors, regardless of distance. With this upgrade, your tower’s workflow will be smoother than ever, allowing you to place critical workstations wherever you see fit. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40684736/3a8e55a60d279ee036f92e1f36ebb69a8ea88760.png[/img]
The tubes can significantly enhance the efficiency of your text and image production chain by directly connecting desks, even across different floors.
Instead of carrying items from one desk to another, climbing stairs, or waiting for the elevator, employees can send them straight to the next desk using the pneumatic tubes.

As a reminder, the flowchart illustrates the sequential steps of the production chain for text and images, from their source to the printer. Connect some of them with tubes - you'll thank us later!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40684736/a6ae5d7c08f064e5ceee816ff64ca0f6da1f4ee4.png[/img]

[h2]IMPROVEMENTS[/h2]

[h3]Revamped transportation AI[/h3]

This overhaul ensures that your employees make smarter, more dynamic decisions to keep your operations running smoothly. This upgrade was essential to fully integrate the pneumatic tubes and dumbwaiter into your tower’s logistics, enabling your employees to cooperate, improving the efficiency of transport across all floors.

[h3]Employee List revamped to Staff Board[/h3]

The Staff Board makes employee management easier than ever. You can toggle jobs and skills, view the number of employees assigned to each role, and sort traits and skills efficiently. Expanded employee cards now provide detailed information at a glance. 

[h3]New Employee Traits[/h3]

We’ve added a variety of traits tailored to automatic desks and foreign news. These include: 

[list]
[*] Policy Hawk: Adds one Quality Star to a Legislative Report. 
[*] Market Maven: Adds one Quality Star to a Stock Index. 
[*] Locker Room Insider: 50% chance of adding an Insider tag to Baseball Results. 
[*] Bloodhound: 50% chance of adding an Evidence tag to a Court Report. 
[*] Anointed Pen: Experience gained from working on Obituaries increased by 10% 
[*] Astrologist: Task speed on Horoscopes increased by 25% but has a 50% chance of adding a Lie. 
[*] Psychic: 25% chance of adding a Forecast tag to Horoscopes and 25% chance of unlocking the next story file within news. 
[*] Parisian Socialite: 25% faster reporting times for stories that take place in Paris. 
[*] Berlin Observer: 25% faster reporting times for stories that take place in Berlin. 
[*] London Insider: 25% faster reporting times for stories that take place in London. 
[*] Kremlin Confidant: 25% faster reporting times for stories that take place in Moscow and Leningrad. 
[*] Roman Consul: 25% faster reporting times for stories that take place in Rome. 
[*] Continental Connector: Increases research speed by 20% for all foreign news. 
[*] Polyglot: Opens up Language Barrier locks in news. 
[*] Diplomat: Opens up Diplomatic Route locks in news. 
[/list]
[h3]Tutors across 1931 [/h3]

To ensure players don’t miss out on important mechanics, we’ve introduced tutors across the 1931 timeline. These guides highlight key features, such as the Europe radio tower, dumbwaiter, pneumatic tubes, advertising systems, graphics processing chains, and the rush button. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40684736/985c1899b032d37b66e620c3bbd14b4363edd0f0.png[/img]

[h2]Improvements with the help of the community [/h2] 

[h3]Overhauled Europe Content Algorithm [/h3]

The Europe content algorithm has had a complete overhaul and is now completely separated from the rest of the content algorithm. This ensures that all necessary tags for districts or quests will always be available in North America, preventing the game from becoming more difficult when unlocking Europe. 

[h3]Globe Filter Lights[/h3]

Globe filters help you prioritise your telegraphers’ efforts towards tags you need. Their lights will now have three states:  
[list]
[*] Solid green: The tag can be found on the currently displayed continent. 
[*] Blinking green: This newly added state indicates that the tag can be found on a different continent.  
[*] Red: The tag has been depleted from the pool for the current week. 
[/list]
[h3]Production employees can assist with transportation [/h3]

All production employees can now help with transportation—except the lawyer, who remains focused on lawsuits.  

Employees will prioritise their own desk but are not restricted to it.  

Preference is given to transporting items on the same floor or nearby, but this is not mandatory. 

[h3]Smarter Pre-Transport Planning [/h3]

notes.title: Dev Diary #3: A global journey begins!
notes.content:
Greetings, Newsbearers!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40684736/2bbebf9bce1a16bf9f68bbf234e5b3eb6a718e89.png[/img]

[h2]Happy New Year from the entire News Tower team! 🎉 [/h2]

We hope 2025 brings you exciting adventures, both in real life and within the bustling halls of your growing newspaper empire. As the world turns the page to a new chapter, we’re ready to share some of the exciting new content of our next update: "[i]Going International[/i]".

Today, we'll give you a preview of the major features and changes that will take your publication beyond New York and onto the global stage. We hope you're ready to face the challenges of reporting across borders! Additionally, we’ll touch on a more serious topic and discuss how we’ve integrated it into the game.

Without further ado, let’s explore how your newsroom will soon capture the pulse of the world!


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40684736/77a068ee6a5ce6beb79403a42ca57c37e16abf6d.png[/img]

[h3]The next update is called “Going International”. Where is it taking us? [/h3]

Europe! This is the first time we will open up a [b]new continent[/b]. With more continents to come later on. But this update is not only about that. The [b]new Pneumatic tube[/b] and [b]dumwaiter transporting systems[/b] are a big part of it too. And so is the reworked Employee list, for managing all your employees. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40684736/a521fcd702b2fb5fb907150664ae40bcd97d518a.png[/img]

[h3]The 1930’s in Europe were marked by significant historical events, including the rise of facism and Nazism. How does News Tower approach these themes, and what can the players expect to see (or not see) in the game?[/h3]

There were big conflicts of ideologies on the continent. The Spanish civil war, Italian fascism, Nazi Germany, all fueled by political unrest set aflame by the great depression. Narration wise, the rise of Nazi Germany is something we really wanted to tell through news articles. Show what political turmoil can lead to and that the press and censorship play a big role in that. That governments can slowly slide away through disinformation and propaganda. But it’s not only going to be dark sad news you can find, some humor and cool facts can be found throughout too. 

We don’t want it to be too complicated gameplay wise since you still are an American newspaper, but expect some [b]new Reporter traits[/b] like Diplomat, Polyglot and others that are specifically tailored for European news items. 

Also, new news item layouts and all come with travel tickets, so [b]travel times [/b]really start to matter in this update. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40684736/8245256456965f397e342df6091bf2381564e7d6.png[/img]

[h3]How did you decide where to draw the line between historical accuracy and maintaining News Tower’s lighthearted and creative tone?[/h3] 

News Tower is a game about newspaper headlines. In a sense, we are already curating it a bit, we can’t go in depth that much. So that flattens the truth, but if the player learns just a little through the game, that is a win in our mind. To us, History is one of the key elements of the game, and a fun part of it is we can entertain and educate at the same time. So almost all the news are accurate, and really took place in the actual month. We cover a rough period, but we sort of look at it from a bird's point of view, while acknowledging the seriousness and pain it caused. We mixed that with some fictional humorous news from time to time to keep it breathable and lighthearted.

[h3]Generally speaking, how do you approach integrating real-world history into a game like News Tower?[/h3]

First we start researching all of the big news items from that period. We want to at least cover all the main events, so lots of browsing on historic newspapers and event overviews. Very fun, but time consuming! 

Once they are all in a spreadsheet (Event, Location and link to source), we select them to be roughly even in terms of categories and start converting them into one big headline and subheadlines, locations per story-file and a Reporter comment on the event. We mostly do this to bring extra context or lightness to the News. 

After that, we can start implementing it. Internally, it looks like this: 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40684736/4567e88a66c0b6202133ace2a6de68415b108f7b.png[/img]

You can see how we label each news item. Labeling is very important for the game system to be able to spawn a news event in the right place and at the right time. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40684736/4bf5d3c2eaf42f5a8726819b6a28bf646f2ef655.png[/img]
[i]We're slipping you some 'insider information' with these behind-the-scenes screenshots, so don't tell anybody.[/i] ;) 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40684736/a6ae5d7c08f064e5ceee816ff64ca0f6da1f4ee4.png[/img]

[h3]The new continent is obviously the main feature of this update, but there is a lot more going on. For instance, were pneumatic tubes a common form of office travel in the 1930’s? And why aren’t we using them today, they sound fun![/h3]

They are fun and there are a few still in use today. Some hospitals in big cities where traffic is a big problem use it to shoot medicines through. But most of them have been removed. In the 1930's though, they were a perfect way of transporting documents all around. 

As the players will notice, in the game it is the fastest way to get something to the top of your tower... And it just looks and sounds awesome.

[h3]What else should the players look forward to?[/h3]

The pneumatic tube and dumbwaiter transport systems bring a whole new dynamic to your tower. Once unlocked, they will bring many new ways to layout your tower. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40684736/857eee00f654e9c6ddda111792be8c7a77e02792.png[/img]
[i]Want to put the typesetting desk at the top of your building? No problem! With a super fast pneumatic tube system, those reports are there in no time.[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40684736/98b140a6820b5232bcdb795fe610cd63e594c38d.png[/img]
[i]With the dumbwaiter, resources like coal, paper and food can now easily be transferred to places without needing to be slowly carried up the stairs.[/i]

For this to work, we really had to bring big changes to our employee AI. The cooperation between employees is what the new transportation AI tries to solve. In previous versions, every employee would decide for itself what to pick up. There was an overarching system that made some suggestions about what item would be best to go to a certain destination, but in the end, the employees thought only for themselves. 

With this update, the employees have a sort of “hive” mind in which everybody that is available is taken into consideration. Based on scientific research done in real world transportation cost optimization, the tasks are assigned so that the total cost of all tasks combined is minimized. Crucially, the system is able to look ahead in deciding what task to assign to whom. This allows cooperation in situations like: “I can start walking now to that dumbwaiter because I know somebody will send an item there in 15 seconds”.

This brings a whole new dynamic to your tower that the players can use to their advantage. 

[h3]How can the community help shape or give feedback on this update? [/h3]

Before the update goes live, we'll be inviting community testers to join us, with full details coming in about two weeks.

For the European continent we are curious what players think about the new news layouts and employee traits interplay. Is that too hard to manage? Should we tune it differently?
We do like the feel of specialising reporters, we think it is one way to do that. 

Since our new employee AI system is totally reworked, lots of players testing/playing will give us great insights. We might find rare bugs, or gameplay that we could tweak better. In general, we are very curious on how players will work with the new pneumatic tube and dumbwaiter system. 

We're also eager to see what fun and optimised tower layouts they can find and what suggestions and feedback they bring around using them in general. Is it making comfort too easy to manage? Is is too complicated to install in crowded towers? That is one example of feedback we received when we implemented the first Elevators, and we were still debating and testing to improve them. 

As for the the employee list rework, we are just curious if every function a player needs is in. We're open for suggestions on that too. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40684736/a6ae5d7c08f064e5ceee816ff64ca0f6da1f4ee4.png[/img]

As we wrap up this deep dive, we hope you're as excited as we are about the new content! We've covered a lot today... So let us know if you found it interesting, or if you'd prefer shorter dev diaries! 

We've said it time and again, but your feedback is invaluable in shaping the future of News Tower. So thank you for being part of this journey with us!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40684736/77a068ee6a5ce6beb79403a42ca57c37e16abf6d.png[/img]

[h3]If you're interested, be sure to join our [url=https://x.com/NewsTowerGame]Twitter[/url] for the latest news, and our [/h3][h3][url=http://discord.gg/EX5YHAJaVK]Discord community[/url] to exchange with us and other like-minded Newsbearers.[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40684736/bc77014ebb42ab9982afbda9a400c0648c7f145d.png[/img]

notes.content:
Greetings, Newsbearers!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40684736/082bb172e71beea16f223a2f1d0b7bffa883470d.png[/img]

[h2]Dev Diary #2 is here, with an inside scoop! [/h2]

Merely a couple of weeks since the first Dev Diary and we're already coming to you with the second edition! With good reason too, because the next update is already around the corner: planned for [b]next week[/b]. This time, we're bringing you insider intel on the latest content development, so brace yourselves for priviledged information you will definitely not find printed anywhere else! 
Hey, in a sense, coming here to read those words is top notch investigative journalism, wouldn't you agree? So good job to you! 

...And now, let's deliver on the scoop! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40684736/7664e37c01725c852b2462f701c870be728407d3.png[/img]

[h3]We have promised GREAT intel, so.... What's coming in the next update?![/h3]

The main feature of the update is called [b]Supplementary Desks[/b]. We'll explain what they are in a moment, but you can expect the following: 

[b]- Court Report (Crime)
- Legislative report (Politics)
- Stock Index (Economy)
- Obituary (Society)
- Horoscope (Entertainment)
- Baseball Report (Sports)[/b]

All of them come with their own distinctive reactive print visuals. Of course that is not it, the update will also bring you other features, such as a [b]6th Page module for your printer[/b], [b]another year[/b], which is 1935, with its own news content, [b]extra news items[/b] for 1934... We have also given employee AI a very deep overhaul, and there are some other additions which we will reveal when the update releases. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40684736/050de4ce292fa8027469ba4418a2f54002c0e97e.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40684736/3db92eb1620a441182b879bbeb059e456cf916df.png[/img]

[h3]Going back to Supplementary Desks, what exactly are they? How do they work?[/h3]

There is one desk for each of the categories mentioned. They are currently unlocked on the map via influence points. Once you assign a reporter with the right category skill to a desk, it will automatically generate a supplementary article every X number of days. 
These reporters can still be used on news reporting, but this will halt their “automatic” work on the Supplementary article.

Supplementary articles come with one base tag (in their category) and some secondary attributes. These can be a silver tag, multiple bronze or even outright money or influence.
Once created at the desk, supplementary articles follow the chain just like other news items would.  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40684736/ac00601a19a0020e1889143e29e60e9f7072639c.png[/img]

[h3]What are the main benefits of this new feature? How does it impact the way we manage our newspaper?[/h3]

There are two main benefits:

[b]Combo setup[/b]
Our idea is that the player can “specialise” a bit more with these Supplementary Articles. Since they come with a category base tag it becomes a little bit easier to plan around one or two types of categories. The more you have of one type, the more affiliated Ads you get.

[b]Automated “Filler” content[/b]
Another element is that over time we want to expand the number of printer pages.
These supplementary Articles are one way of gaining more content without overwhelming the player with lots of micromanagement, thanks to the automated element of creation.

And of course, their own distinct visuals make your newspaper look cooler!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40684736/fc19557b250147530b4cd00c392a903815c68cfd.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40684736/3db92eb1620a441182b879bbeb059e456cf916df.png[/img]

[h3]The update also comes with the addition of the year 1935. Is there anything we should look out for from that particular year?
[/h3]

For now, this is just another added year with its own Breaking and normal news items. It is highlighting the big events of that year, such as the legendary Amelia Earhart becoming the first person to fly solo from Hawaii to California, or some of the heaviest storms within the Dust Bowl that ruined the midlands.

In the future, more specific calendar events will trigger each year. So later on during early access 1935 will have more in store for the player.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40684736/3db92eb1620a441182b879bbeb059e456cf916df.png[/img]

[h3]Can you share any insights into the development process for this update? Any challenge you encountered?[/h3]

The Supplementary desks part was fairly straight forward to design and implement.
Of course, we will monitor it for balance and such. We love the new combo setup and the visual variety within your newspaper.

The tricky part was the [b]Employee AI rework[/b].

We tried patching for quite some time to get things right but eventually had to rework lots of it from the ground up. We understand that for the players, employee AI can become a frustration since it directly affects on the production chain time.

In previous versions, when an employee was evaluating its options for picking a destination (e.g. which toilet to visit) it would take into account several factors (how busy, is it broken, etc…) combined with an approximation of the distance it had to walk to that destination. This system was easily fooled however if the tower contained closed off walls. The approximation did not take into account these walls and would incorrectly assume that a destination would be very close, while in reality the employee would have to walk several stairs to actually get there. AI decision making is never just about distance. It needs to take into account a lot of other stuff and weigh it off against how far it is. This was hard to reason about. 

The new system solves this by [b]actually calculating the distance that needs to be walked[/b]. A smart caching system is used to save on calculations. And when there is too much heat and the calculations can’t keep up, an approximation is used as a substitute and the approximation is soon after replaced by the actual distance. With this new system, the AI decision making is easier to reason about as certain priorities can be expressed in terms of: “How many seconds is this guy allowed to walk extra when there is a queue of 3 people at the coffee machine”. 

Now that actual distances are used, [b]the resource transportation also had a complete overhaul[/b]. You will notice resupply employees making far better decisions. Taking into account several factors such as distance, priority, storages and whatnot.

The [b]AI now takes into account the status of an elevator[/b] and may pick a different elevator, or the stairs, if it is really crowded. Fingers crossed that the elevators now become way more useful! Of Course, inefficient placement will not help, so you still need to be careful when placing your elevators.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40684736/3db92eb1620a441182b879bbeb059e456cf916df.png[/img]

[h3]Are you already at work on future updates too, or do you typically work on each update one step at a time?[/h3]

Always! We have these update deadlines but we usually also work on the bigger picture mechanics/systems.

The update after this one will be massive. We're working on a big NPC overhaul, a new continent, image supplementary desks and even a Pneumatic tube transport system. All of these elements are already quite far in, content and coding wise. At the same time, a lot of [b]localisation pre-work[/b] is being done in the background. 

So to be more precise, we always work on multiple updates at the same time. With a small team we need to be efficient with our time and planning. As the community knows, some features might slide from one update to the next, but there is a grander plan at work here. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40684736/3db92eb1620a441182b879bbeb059e456cf916df.png[/img]

[h3]That's it for Dev Diary #2! That was quite a lot, right? With that sort of knowledge, who wouldn't want to brag on [url=https://x.com/NewsTowerGame]Twitter[/url] or [url=http://discord.gg/EX5YHAJaVK]Discord[/url]? [/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40684736/7664e37c01725c852b2462f701c870be728407d3.png[/img]

[h3]Encounter bugs? Want to chat with the devs and the community? Have a suggestion to improve the game?[/h3]

[h3][url=http://discord.gg/EX5YHAJaVK]Join our Discord community![/url][/h3]

notes.title: Dev Diary #1: Let's talk about Traits!
notes.content:
Good day, Newsbearers!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40684736/082bb172e71beea16f223a2f1d0b7bffa883470d.png[/img]

[h2]Welcome to your newest Dev Diary series![/h2]

With this format we'll give you an exclusive behind-the-scenes look at the team crafting News Tower! We’ll explore various aspects of the game's development—art, design, gameplay mechanics, and more. We'll mainly focus on giving you snippets of future content, buuut because we're a little late in publishing this first one, we'll have a focus on the previous update instead... Just this one time!  
We're all news reporters here, we all know it's not good to let a great story go to waste! ;) 

So whether you've already played the update and you want a deeper understanding OR you're new to the game and want to see what the game features are all about, we welcome you to dive into this inside scoop! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40684736/7664e37c01725c852b2462f701c870be728407d3.png[/img]

[h3]Can you give us an overview of the new “employee traits” system introduced in the latest update?[/h3]

In this update we wanted to bring some personality to your employees and at the same time bring a skillful twist to existing pillar mechanics of News Tower.

Traits come in two types: [b]Personality traits[/b] and [b]Trainable traits[/b].

[list][*][b]Personality traits[/b] finally make the hiring process more interesting. From now on employees personality traits really can bring a boost to your tower and at the same time have funny flavorful quirks.
[b]Example:[/b] [i]Highlander – +3% workspeed for every floor below their workplace.[/i]

[*][b]Trainable traits[/b] are more rare and overall better traits that players can assign to employees in the training menu, so they learn/gain that trait.
These traits can bring real game changers.
[b]Example:[/b] [i]Coordinator – Allows opening the next story-file within a news item immediately after assignment.[/i][/list]Some personality traits combo perfectly with trainable traits, allowing you to create the ultimate employee!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40684736/e64deadb1e1ce43b5da82183326563f1b9f4791b.png[/img]

Beyond traits, we've also added the [b]'Monthly calendar'[/b] for unlocking rewards in a cool new interactive way and activated the [b]'Prestige system'[/b].

Employees who now reach the max base level of 5 become senior and require Prestige to gain an extra bonus boost. Prestige works almost like comfort but requires different objects that make these employees' surroundings more prestigious. For example, some basic comfort items from early game are unprestigious and will need to be replaced with more prestigious ones!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40684736/3db92eb1620a441182b879bbeb059e456cf916df.png[/img]

[h3]What inspired the addition of this new system to News Tower?[/h3]

We always wanted you to treasure your employees more and really bond with your reporter team! [b]Traits[/b] help achieve this and add a layer of strategic choice to the reporting phase, without complicating the basics.

For the [b]Monthly calendar[/b], our goal has long been to introduce something more connected to the yearly cycle, complementing the existing weekly gameplay. This Calendar is part of the perception bar system and adds this extra layer to it that it really missed.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40684736/a718861e811ab976c65f1ebd9c5f77876bd064e4.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40684736/3db92eb1620a441182b879bbeb059e456cf916df.png[/img]

[h3]How do you envision these changes enhancing the gameplay experience?[/h3]

[b]Employee Traits[/b] hopefully bring personality and strategic choices to the news item reporting.

The [b]Monthly Calendar[/b] provides long-term goals to work towards and increase the interest of the perception system.

The [b]Prestige System[/b] incentivizes you to decorate your tower and make it your own. Unlike Comfort, which only negatively affects employees, Prestige only acts as a bonus buff coming form a positive angle!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40684736/a2e9cbd9393bc1a049e93d40b70c71f9a1f4f439.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40684736/3db92eb1620a441182b879bbeb059e456cf916df.png[/img]

[h3]Can you share any insights into the development process for this new feature?[/h3]

One of the trickiest parts of News Tower development is working with so many connected elements/mechanics. So even little changes have big effects and need extra checking and testing. This update for example, we introduced Traits, which are active in the game almost from the start. It was an opportunity for us to take a look, with a fresh perspective, at most of the existing mechanics, because a change like this one affects the balancing greatly, and potentially introduces weird bugs!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40684736/3db92eb1620a441182b879bbeb059e456cf916df.png[/img]

[h3]How do you plan to further develop these systems based on player feedback and data?[/h3]

We choose for fun and maybe have some traits on the overpowered side a little! 
Having the community help find trait combinations that might be a little too good and adjust accordingly if needed. We really think this can be a fun new phase for the game, where the community feedback will have a great impact.  The community might come up with trait ideas we didn’t even think of. We are always open to new funky ideas and the traits system is ideal for that. 
Besides, we want the new features and the tutorials to remain clear enough for everyone to understand. We don’t want to lose the casual side of our game. With tycoons, It’s easy to overload the player with Tutorials, menus and Ui. So we'll closely monitor this side as well.
You can already see the impact of the community's feedback on the game: We added Prestige for the Utility employees in the patch 0.18.126r, based on the suggestions made on Discord by some of our community members.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40684736/c235d86b476b9b4ecbc46c60a8e8ab3dd2deb94b.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40684736/3db92eb1620a441182b879bbeb059e456cf916df.png[/img]

We hope this gave you a better understanding of Employee Traits and where they are coming from, even if it was "old news"! ;) . 
 
We promise, next time, we'll give you a sneak peek (world premiere!) at some of the upcoming features. We already have a date and the content mapped out and you will not have to wait very long! Until then, [b]keep those presses rolling[/b]!  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40684736/7664e37c01725c852b2462f701c870be728407d3.png[/img]

[h3]Encounter bugs? Want to chat with the devs and the community? Have a suggestion to improve the game?[/h3]

notes.title: EMPLOYEE OF THE MONTH UPDATE
notes.content:
[h2]Good day, Newsbearers![/h2]
 
The staff is ready, their skills polished, and the [b]Employee of the Month[/b] update has arrived, bringing exciting new traits to your newsroom!

Following a successful community test phase, we’re eager to share these new features with you! Your feedback was instrumental in perfecting this update, and now it’s time to watch your newsroom and your employees thrive.

[i](PS: pssst, there's a 'special thanks' at the end of this blog post for all community testers!)[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40684736/c9bd0c01cf08de17006addef48d84df8d25fc408.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40684736/77a068ee6a5ce6beb79403a42ca57c37e16abf6d.png[/img]

[h2]What's included in this 'Employee of the Month' update?[/h2]

[list][*][b]Employee Traits System[/b]: In this new update we wanted to bring some personality to your employees, and at the same time bring a skillful twist to existing pillar mechanics of News Tower.

[*][b]Monthly Calendar[/b]: We added this calendar to unlock rewards in a cool new and interactive way. Our goal has long been to introduce something more connected to the yearly cycle, complementing the existing weekly and monthly gameplay. This Calendar is part of the perception bar system and adds this extra layer to it that it really missed.

[*][b]Prestige System[/b]: Employees who now reach the max base level of 5 become senior and require Prestige to gain an extra bonus boost. Prestige works almost like comfort but requires different objects that make these employees' surroundings more prestigious.

[*][b]New in-game year[/b]: There is also a whole new in-game year: 1934! This should give you plenty of time to enjoy all the new features we've included in this update.

[*][b]Optimization[/b]: We've optimized the game by reducing loading times, improving performance for larger towers, and lowering memory usage by trimming oversized assets.[/list]
These new features are thoroughly listed below in the changelog, and will be explained in detail by the devs themselves in the upcoming series of Dev Diaries!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40684736/a6ae5d7c08f064e5ceee816ff64ca0f6da1f4ee4.png[/img]

[h2]Should I start a new game?[/h2]

We highly recommend starting a new game with the introduction to fully experience the latest additions. 

If you continue with an existing save, you might miss out on important changes, such as trait assignments and managing employee prestige needs. Starting fresh will allow the tutorials to guide you step-by-step, ensuring you make the most of these new features!


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40684736/985c1899b032d37b66e620c3bbd14b4363edd0f0.png[/img]

[h2]KEY ADDITIONS[/h2]

[h3]EMPLOYEE TRAITS[/h3]
[list][*]Employees now possess Traits that can enhance your tower's performance beyond their basic levels. Here are just three examples of the many traits available:
[list][*][b]Yearly Peaker[/b]: Gains a 2% speed increase on tasks every month, but resets in January. 
[*][b]Musical[/b]: Likes to sing and counters noise. 
[*][b]Perfect Angle[/b]: 50% chance of taking the perfect shot and adding one quality star to a photo.[/list][*]Traits are categorized into two types: Personality Traits and Trainable Traits.  
[list][*][b]Personality Traits[/b] are inherent to employees, adding complexity to the hiring process. 
[*][b]Trainable Traits[/b] can be unlocked through a calendar event or purchased at one of the Colleges and then taught to an employee of your choosing.[/list][*]Personality Traits are introduced in March 1930 when playing with the intro. Trainable Traits are unlocked when you first encounter one in the monthly calendar or when you purchase one at the Universities.[/list]
[h3]MONTHLY CALENDAR EVENTS[/h3]
[list][*]We’re introducing a Monthly Calendar that offers rewards to seize and risks to avoid.
[*]Rewards include Trainable Traits, objects, Influence Points and money. 
[*]The Monthly Calendar Event unlocks in January 1931.[/list]
[h3]PRESTIGE[/h3]
[list][*]Employees who reach the maximum base level of 5 become senior and require prestige to unlock an additional bonus boost. 
[*]Prestige functions similarly to comfort but requires specific objects that enhance the prestige of the employees' surroundings. 
[*]Some of your older objects may need to be replaced with more prestigious variants. Prestige objects can be bought at shops and unlocked through the monthly calendar.[/list]
[h3]1934[/h3]
[list][*]We added a year of news items, breaking news and calendar events for you to enjoy![/list]
[h3]OPTIMIZATION[/h3]
[list][*]Loading times for starting a new game and loading existing games have been reduced.
[*]Performance has been improved for larger towers.
[*]Reduced memory overhead for some unnecessarily huge assets.[/list]

[h2]IMPROVEMENTS & CHANGES[/h2]
[list][*] Skill levelling speed has been reduced and may be further adjusted during the community test. 
[*] Hempstead district no longer has a photo chain lockout, allowing access to the Trait University that lies behind it without first unlocking the photo chain.
[*] The Mirror now needs to be unlocked at the Ritz Theater.
[*] Numerous bugs have been fixed.[/list]

[h2]OTHER[/h2]
[list][*] Although saves from previous versions are compatible with this update, we strongly recommend starting a new game with the intro to fully experience and understand the new features.[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40684736/b617523ae5eb083a95807e232123a1b5b396f406.png[/img]

[h2]SPECIAL THANKS[/h2]

We want to send a warm, heartfelt thank you to all of you Newsbearers who participated in our Community Test and shared your feedback. Your insights were incredibly valuable and helped us make this update as good as it today!
We’re so grateful for your support and thought you'd like to see the specifics of the changes you helped bring to life- you can find these below!

[b]YOUR CHANGES, NEWSBEARERS![/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40684736/2bbebf9bce1a16bf9f68bbf234e5b3eb6a718e89.png[/img]

[h3]FIXES[/h3]
[list][*]Economist trait typo
[*]Fix golden mirror not being exclusive and not having diminishing returns
[*]Fix Full House trait not working
[*]Hanging plant also selectable in prestige view mode
[*]Morse code hang bug hopefully patched
[*]Perception arrow tooltip displays the max steps it can take
[*]Hicksville shifted to the left a little bit to prevent overlap with drawer
[*]Employee drawer refreshes completely after every situation change in the newsbook
[*]No more “ping” on loadgame related to some (!) unseen indicator on the HUD[/list]
[h3]BALANCING[/h3]
[list][*]Reverted production AI where they will transport chain items to others if they don't have work lined up
[*] Rebalanced caps for quest sales requirements and chances of production employees preferring transport items when they have work are near zero
[*] Repair and resupply have a much lower chance of prioritizing toilet or nutrition (10%)
[*] Rebalance skill up hours and printer paper (salesPerUnit from 150 to 400)[/list]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40684736/bc77014ebb42ab9982afbda9a400c0648c7f145d.png[/img]

And if by some twist of fate you were to find bugs or have more feedback to share with us, head on over to our [url=https://discord.gg/EX5YHAJaVK]Discord[/url] so we can keep fixing and improving News Tower!

notes.title: Community Test - Employee of the Month
notes.content:
[h3]Greetings and gather 'round, newsbearers![/h3]
 
The presses are rolling, the news is hot off the wire, and today the 'Community Test Build' branch is now OPEN!

As you continued showing tremendous support and engagement for News Tower, we have worked hard to make this playtest happen.
In this beta phase, we are testing maaaany new additions and improvements that will be coming this month in the [b]'Employee of the Month' Update[/b], and we are gathering your feedback before we release it on the main branch.
You can find a detailed list of what is implemented in this community test below!

[h3][b]Here's everything you need to know:[/b][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40684736/77a068ee6a5ce6beb79403a42ca57c37e16abf6d.png[/img]

[h2]What's included in the Community Test Build?[/h2]

[list][*][b]Employee Traits System[/b]: In this new update we wanted to bring some personality to your employees, and at the same time bring a skillful twist to existing pillar mechanics of News Tower.

[*][b]Monthly Calendar[/b]: We added this calendar to unlock rewards in a cool new and interactive way. Our goal has long been to introduce something more connected to the yearly cycle, complementing the existing weekly and monthly gameplay. This Calendar is part of the perception bar system and adds this extra layer to it that it really missed.

[*][b]Prestige System[/b]: Employees who now reach the max base level of 5 become senior and require Prestige to gain an extra bonus boost. Prestige works almost like comfort but requires different objects that make these employees' surroundings more prestigious.

[*][b]New in-game year[/b]: There is also a whole new in-game year: 1934! This should give you plenty of time to enjoy all the new features we've included in this update.

[*][b]Optimization[/b]: We've optimized the game by reducing loading times, improving performance for larger towers, and lowering memory usage by trimming oversized assets.[/list]
These new features are thoroughly listed below in the changelog, and will be explained in detail by the devs themselves in the upcoming series of Dev Diaries!

Please remember that this is an early preview build, so there's still room for improvement. Your feedback during this testing phase will play a crucial role in shaping the final version - thank you for your help!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40684736/bc77014ebb42ab9982afbda9a400c0648c7f145d.png[/img]

Join the "Community Test Build" channels on the Discord to share your feedback and questions on this playtest: https://discord.gg/EX5YHAJaVK


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40684736/a6ae5d7c08f064e5ceee816ff64ca0f6da1f4ee4.png[/img]

[h2]Should I start a new game?[/h2]

We highly recommend starting a new game with the introduction to fully experience the latest additions. 

If you continue with an existing save, you might miss out on important changes, such as trait assignments and managing employee prestige needs. Starting fresh will allow the tutorials to guide you step-by-step, ensuring you make the most of these new features!


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40684736/985c1899b032d37b66e620c3bbd14b4363edd0f0.png[/img]

[h2]How do I join the Community Test Build branch on Steam?[/h2]

To access the "Community Test Build" branch, simply follow these steps:

[olist][*]Open the Steam client.
[*]Click on the "Library" tab.
[*]Right-click on "News Tower" and select "Properties".
[*]Click on the "Betas" tab.
[*]In the "Beta participation" field, select "community_test".
[*]Click on the "Close" button.
[*]The game will now be updated to the "community_test" branch.[/olist]
You're in! :)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40684736/31ab2015128ce790699eca84eb06cce7b07381cd.png[/img]

[h2]KEY ADDITIONS[/h2]

[h3]EMPLOYEE TRAITS[/h3]
[list][*]Employees now possess Traits that can enhance your tower's performance beyond their basic levels. Here are just three examples of the many traits available:
[list][*][b]Yearly Peaker[/b]: Gains a 2% speed increase on tasks every month, but resets in January. 
[*][b]Musical[/b]: Likes to sing and counters noise. 
[*][b]Perfect Angle[/b]: 50% chance of taking the perfect shot and adding one quality star to a photo.[/list][*]Traits are categorized into two types: Personality Traits and Trainable Traits.  
[list][*][b]Personality Traits[/b] are inherent to employees, adding complexity to the hiring process. 
[*][b]Trainable Traits[/b] can be unlocked through a calendar event or purchased at one of the Colleges and then taught to an employee of your choosing.[/list][*]Personality Traits are introduced in March 1930 when playing with the intro. Trainable Traits are unlocked when you first encounter one in the monthly calendar or when you purchase one at the Universities.[/list]
[h3]MONTHLY CALENDAR EVENTS[/h3]
[list][*]We’re introducing a Monthly Calendar that offers rewards to seize and risks to avoid.
[*]Rewards include Trainable Traits, objects, Influence Points and money. 
[*]The Monthly Calendar Event unlocks in January 1931.[/list]
[h3]PRESTIGE[/h3]
[list][*]Employees who reach the maximum base level of 5 become senior and require prestige to unlock an additional bonus boost. 
[*]Prestige functions similarly to comfort but requires specific objects that enhance the prestige of the employees' surroundings. 
[*]Some of your older objects may need to be replaced with more prestigious variants. Prestige objects can be bought at shops and unlocked through the monthly calendar.[/list]
[h3]1934[/h3]
[list][*]We added a year of news items, breaking news and calendar events for you to enjoy![/list]
[h3]OPTIMIZATION[/h3]
[list][*]Loading times for starting a new game and loading existing games have been reduced.
[*]Performance has been improved for larger towers.
[*]Reduced memory overhead for some unnecessarily huge assets.[/list]

[h2]IMPROVEMENTS & CHANGES[/h2]
[list][*] Skill levelling speed has been reduced and may be further adjusted during the community test. 
[*] Hempstead district no longer has a photo chain lockout, allowing access to the Trait University that lies behind it without first unlocking the photo chain.
[*] The Mirror now needs to be unlocked at the Ritz Theater.
[*] Numerous bugs have been fixed.[/list]

[h2]OTHER[/h2]
[list][*] Although saves from previous versions are compatible with this update, we strongly recommend starting a new game with the intro to fully experience and understand the new features.[/list]

notes.title: Patch v0.17.85.r
notes.content:
[h2]Good day Newsbearers![/h2]
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40684736/2bbebf9bce1a16bf9f68bbf234e5b3eb6a718e89.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40684736/37eb006cbac6918d8e37ed4069401980efde36f8.png[/img][/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40684736/7664e37c01725c852b2462f701c870be728407d3.png[/img]

[h2]KEY ADDITION[/h2]

[h3][b]Auto resource ordering (Paper, Coal and Food)[/b][/h3]
[list][*] This new feature takes away the burden of needing to order resources manually. You can buy these as upgrades on the NYC map and opt in per resource type. The system will make sure there is always enough available! Do keep in mind that your resupply workers will still need to keep up with the pacing![/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40684736/0e1b8a86758ead3ce2fbda032ac02dbe6aafd58a.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40684736/dd9fbbdecd9c22665a6ce481d84ada4af051123b.png[/img]

[h2]IMPROVEMENTS[/h2]

[list][*]Overall the transportation AI should be a little smarter. A new feature is that the placement of the resupply desk influences which resources get prioritized. For example, placing a resupply desk close to the printer will hint the employee to mainly resupply your printer with paper. 

[list][*]Placement of the supply desk matters. Supply employees prefer targets that are closer to their desk.
[*]Resource transport AI improved.
[*]Repairing + sweeping AI also improved. They prioritize better, also dependant on the proximity to their desk. But if you drop them next to something, they will work on it.
[*]Toilet visits and food visits prefer the same floor or close floors a little more, being a little more tolerant to queues.[/list][/list][list][*][b]Elevator group letters:[/b] Another feature that helps to avoid mistakes. All elevator doors that belong to the same system share the same letter on their display. 
[*][b]Printer requires a little less paper.[/b] Used to be one crate per 5000 sales. Now is one crate per 7500 sales.
[*][b]Tiered resource discounts:[/b] Instead of a single 25% discount on paper, coal and food, the discounts have been split up into 10, 20 and 30 percent.
[*][b]Unreachable room warnings:[/b] A new icon that shows up if a room is unreachable for your employees. This can help to prevent mistakes in your tower’s design!
[*][b]Globe filter lights[/b] now always show red when that category is depleted, even when the button is not engaged.[/list]
[h3][b]Audio[/b][/h3]
[list][*]“New Actions possible” and reward suitcase in news now have a notification sound.
[*]Fixed audio ping sometimes playing on load games.
[*]Eating audio for all eating related objects.[/list]
[h3][b]Miscellaneous[/b][/h3]
[list][*]Splash screen is now skippable.
[*]Mouse cursor is hidden on splash screen.[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40684736/bb00f4e96bad7c7e2952adebcd46b7c0338d2be2.png[/img]

[h2]BUG FIXES[/h2]

[list][*]Fixed telegrapher lamp morse code sound hanging when pausing the game.
[*]Fixed news stand only appearing after when the intro camera has settled.
[*]Fixed bug that occurred if you manually dragged a lawsuit and it expired right at that time causing a corrupted game state.
[*]Duplicate Triumphant tag for Great Neck district is removed.
[*]Fixed newsbook expire time display not displaying LINE CLOSED on last hour before expiration.
[*]Lots of news items have had a dot (.) at the end of the subtitle removed, as this looks strange on the newspaper.[/list]

notes.title: AGE OF PHOTOGRAPHY UPDATE
notes.content:
[h2]Good day Newsbearers![/h2]
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40684736/fcaafe7fe92f9b035798be4173b90f83391a1db8.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40684736/a073de1cc78ab9111d332fa3dbf45c94cc150f30.png[/img][/url]
 
[b]The cameras are flashing, the ink is drying, and today the 'Age of Photography' update enhances your 1930s newsroom experience in News Tower![/b]

With this update, your newsroom gets an exciting makeover, adding depth and new challenges that breathe fresh life into your journalistic empire. 

[h3][b]Here’s why you should jump back in:[/b][/h3]
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40684736/d830852bb84ae88b2b76c002d3019fe58cd436df.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40684736/549677db616baf87ca3879f02bed55dd8cef662a.png[/img][/url]

[list][*][b]Exciting new roles[/b]: Bring on board [b]photographers[/b], [b]cartographers[/b], and [b]illustrators[/b] to give your newspaper a visual edge. These roles open up new strategies and opportunities to boost your paper's appeal and profitability.
[*][b]Reader's Perception system[/b]: Shape your newspaper’s identity! Will you be a sensational tabloid or a reputable source of in-depth news? Your choices now impact subscriber loyalty and your paper's long-term success.
[*][b]New year, new stories[/b]: Experience the events of 1933 with an enriched narrative that includes both historical and fictional news, making each edition more compelling than ever.[/list]
To fully appreciate these updates, we highly recommend starting a new game with the tutorials enabled. They'll guide you through the new features step-by-step, ensuring you make the most of these exciting additions!


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40684736/803f9e5c74427af69de19775fc34bdb5d9f777f8.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40684736/b617523ae5eb083a95807e232123a1b5b396f406.png[/img]

[h2]Important information regarding your saves[/h2]

The game should clearly state that your previous saves are incompatible with this new update due to the numerous additions and changes we had to implement.
However, here is what you need to know about this topic, just in case!

[b]You will:[/b] 
[list][*]Have to create a new game and new save with this update.[/list][b]You will not be able to:[/b]
[list][*]Continue playing with your old saves - that means both the saves from the previous build on the main branch AND the saves from the Community Test Build.[/list][b]However[/b], we are creating a [b]legacy branch[/b] that you can switch to if you want to finish the game you had going on in the previous build.
It will be accessible to everyone at the same time as this update goes live, and you can use it to continue your ongoing games. This branch will not be updated in the future - it is only here so you can finish your current games :)


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40684736/1053429d21f6ebf6f5022d15ac8f293cee38358c.png[/img]

[h2]KEY ADDITIONS[/h2]

[h3][b]IMAGE PRODUCTION CHAIN[/b][/h3]

[h3]Your newspaper is getting a massive upgrade![/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40684736/f6136cd6789bfe893c05ab92a9d996a4b723721e.png[/img]

[list][*][h3][b]Photographer[/b] - Can add a picture to news item (Gold tag)[/h3]

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40684736/8598b26970b88e295a54c8ce06b41bdc942a08dd.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40684736/9186be14e6fb9af3f1b5869fc85e1447384b8784.png[/img][/url]

[list][*]Photographer desk - This is where the photographer sits when it’s not assigned to a news item. Similar to how reporter desks work.
[*]Darkroom - Unique to photographs. When the photographer comes back from a news item, he/she develops the negatives into a “real” photograph. The darkroom can not be under a regular light. There is a red development light available as a buff item.
[*]Repro Camera - “Scans” the photo into a format that can be used by the engraver for creating the printable image.
[*]Engraver - Makes a printable “mold” of the image. After this step the graphic is ready to be assembled.
[*]Assembler - As with any item that can be placed in the newspaper, the final step is the assembler.[/list][/list]
[list][*][h3][b]Cartographer[/b] - Can add a map to news item (Silver tag)[/h3]

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40684736/69546e8e069b3ff510c058e2a48b0b891c2769e3.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40684736/0a932539dd760a0f89ab22ea72ca1b36f2500285.png[/img][/url]

[list][*]Cartographer desk - This is where the cartographer sits when it’s not assigned to a news item. Similar to how reporter desks work.
[*]The cartographer chain is similar to the photo chain, except that it does need to go into the darkroom.[/list][/list]
[list][*][h3][b]Illustrator[/b] - Can add an illustration to ads (extra money)[/h3]

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40684736/8e8c7bb73f5fc8e6955970ddea9029802f02b485.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40684736/fe620d9daa134506f7d1d440e5952ff1a5d7c3ab.png[/img][/url]

[list][*]Illustrator desk - This is where the illustrator sits when it’s not assigned to a news item. Similar to how reporter desks work.
[*]The illustrator chain is similar to the photo chain, except that it does need to go into the darkroom.[/list][/list]
[h3]Here is a quick look of an image production chain in our news tower!![/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40684736/46acf1735daa9485aa4e3493cc0a608167322406.png[/img]

[b]NEW (BUFF) OBJECTS:[/b]
	
[list][*] Photographer desk: Camera Cabinet, Camera Cleaning Kit, Camera Tripod
[*] Darkroom Technician: Chemicals Cabinet, Development Light, Dry Mount Press, Blackout Curtains
[*] Repro Camera / Photoprocessor: Sharpness Chart, Wet Plate Rack, Blackout Curtains
[*] Engraver: Drying Oven, Engraving Equipment, White Coat Rack
[*] Illustrator: Desk Pencils, Paint Can Cabinet, Painting Easel
[*] Cartographer: Drafting Triangles, Map Cabinet, Telescope, World Map
[*] Sweeping: Sweeping Tools, Big Trash Can (already existed but now buffs sweeping)
[*] Editor: Dictionary Books, File Cabinet, Issue Board, Paper Cutter[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40684736/a6ae5d7c08f064e5ceee816ff64ca0f6da1f4ee4.png[/img]

[h3][b]READERS' PERCEPTION[/b][/h3]

We are introducing a new mechanic called “Perception”. It’s about how your readers perceive your newspaper. You can be a “Sensational” newspaper, focusing more on fast, tabloid style news. Or an “Informational” newspaper, with more in depth coverage. The middle ground is also possible and it’s called “Moderate”.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40684736/b85f19c039a72d422b219ae4eabfadf25d44c8a7.png[/img]

We are laying a foundation to build upon in future updates, where perception will play a big role in long term planning, rivaling newspapers and other interesting mechanics.
With this update, its main focus is gathering subscribers.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40684736/985c1899b032d37b66e620c3bbd14b4363edd0f0.png[/img]


Some of the tags that you will encounter have a “Perception side” associated with them. For example, the “Gossip” tag, skews your perception towards Sensational.

When you assemble your newspaper, the total perception value gets summed for the articles, and that determines the character of your newspaper.

Every week, the public perception gets nudged towards the character of your latest print. This moves rather slowly, simulating the real world where public perception doesn’t change overnight.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40684736/73812daed75b0ddefdd726927330d081797a2415.png[/img]

A big change that comes with this new mechanic is that the subscribers you gather from completing districts are no longer subscribers directly. Instead, they become “Potential” subscribers. They have gotten to know your newspaper based on the character of your latest edition. In order for them to subscribe, you have to be consistent in your newspaper’s character. The potential subscribers remember the character of your newspaper, and if you stay consistent, they will become subscribers after a couple of weeks.

Every perception “side” (Sensational, Moderate, Informational) has a distinct set of negative tags associated with them. For example, if the perception of your newspaper is Sensational, readers may find certain stories boring. With this update, you will probably not notice this as the content that utilizes this is still a work in progress.

Reader's Perception gets introduced and unlocked after you’ve completed 12 districts on the N.Y.C. map. Before it is unlocked, the subscriber system works the same as before.

Again, this update is laying the foundation of this mechanic. Expect more in-depth and interesting mechanics using the perception system in future updates.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40684736/a6ae5d7c08f064e5ceee816ff64ca0f6da1f4ee4.png[/img]

[h3][b]1933[/b][/h3]

For the Community Test version, the content of this news is still placeholder content.
For the full release, the news will utilize a mix of events that truly happened in 1933 and some fake events we created to give additional content.
The new content also uses the new graphic chain items like photographs, illustrations and maps.

[i][b]What about scores then?[/b][/i]

Scores that were made with an older version of News Tower aren’t valid anymore. We’ve added so much new content that it doesn’t make sense to compare old scores with the new ones.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40684736/1053429d21f6ebf6f5022d15ac8f293cee38358c.png[/img]

[h2]SMALLER ADDITIONS[/h2]

[h3][b]AD BOYCOTT[/b][/h3]
 
You’ve printed something controversial and the ad companies aren’t too happy with that.
You will be punished and get only partial, or no ad deals at all!

[h3][b]AD QUALITY SYSTEM[/b][/h3]

With the addition of the illustrator, you can now make higher quality ads that contain illustrations. An illustrated ad is unlocked if you hit the top tier (8) in a given category.

[h3][b]AREA MAP LEGEND[/b][/h3]

Visible from january 1930, the area map legend helps you navigate the map. It shows you where all of the upgrades in a given category can be found.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40684736/22db70eb5375d615b0f975ca7ef00914aa85f12e.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40684736/1053429d21f6ebf6f5022d15ac8f293cee38358c.png[/img]
 
 
[h2]IMPROVEMENTS & CHANGES[/h2]
 
[h3][b]EDITOR[/b][/h3]
[list][*]Text (copy) editor and graphic editor remove all pre-production nags. 
[list][*]The editor was undercooked in previous versions. With this update, the editor removes all negative tags from an item. (Except for sloppy production and old news, because this can happen after the editor by for example a sloppy typesetter).
[*]Negative tags now have a larger sales penalty, so in most cases it makes sense to edit those negative tags out. This is of course at the cost of longer production times…
[*]You have to manually enable the editor in the reporting menu itself. It will appear as a checkbox beneath the story file.
[*]Enabling the editor later is also possible via the right drawer. Click on the small diamond that represents the editor to toggle it on and off. Note that once the item has passed the editing stage, it is not possible to toggle it anymore.
[*]Editor can be enabled directly on the story file (if applicable). Default is OFF for now.[/list][/list]
[h3][b]MISCELLANEOUS[/b][/h3]
[list][*]Added numerous new sound effects and ambience sounds.
[*]Newspaper x3 and x2 slots instead of only the above the fold
[*]Toggle all notifications at once can be done with N by default[/list]
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40684736/1053429d21f6ebf6f5022d15ac8f293cee38358c.png[/img]
 
[h2]BUG FIXES[/h2]
[list][*]Fixed tower score recording ad revenue and newspaper sales profit a week behind
[*]Fixed employees picking an occupied side at the coffee machine
[*]Chain bubble log overhauled where it's now a separate root like Rush Mode brains and no longer interferes with employee logs
[*]Various minor fixes[/list]

Join the community to talk with the dev team, other players, and share your feedback anytime you want! We care about your opinion and will take the time to answer to each and everyone of you! ❤
