notes.content:
[h3][b]Welcome and gather 'round, newsbearers and aspiring media moguls of the roaring 1930s![/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40684736/2bbebf9bce1a16bf9f68bbf234e5b3eb6a718e89.png[/img] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40684736/921ef32e8688c0499ff6c08b593e4f1e2514ff46.png[/img]
 
The presses are rolling, the news is hot off the wire, and today the 'Community Test Build' branch is now OPEN!

As you continued showing your unwavering enthusiasm for News tower, we have worked hard to make this playtest happen.
In this initial phase, we are testing many new additions and improvements and are gathering your feedback and opinion on it to improve it as much as we can before we release it on the main branch.
You can find a detailed list of what is implemented in this community test below!

[h3][b]Here's everything you need to know:[/b][/h3]


[h2]What's included in the Community Test Build?[/h2]

[list][*]Reader's Perception: This is a brand new system that will be detailed in the changelog below. The key point here is that it will be unlocked once you have obtained 12 districts. We will keep improving and enriching this system with future updates.
[*]Image Production Chain: This new production chain lets you add a cartographer, photographer, and illustrator to your team. We have also added a bunch of buff items for the new equipment in this production chain!
[*]Last but not least as one says, we have also added a whole new in-game year: 1933. This should give you plenty of time to enjoy all the new features we've included in this update.[/list]
These new features are thoroughly explained in the game's tutorials. We highly recommend starting a new game "with an introduction" to fully understand and explore them. The tutorials will guide you step-by-step, ensuring you make the most of these additions!

Keep in mind this is a preview build, and as such, much will still have to be improved. This is also why we ask for your help!

Join the "Community Test Build" channels on the Discord to share your feedback on this playtest: https://discord.gg/V9ZRjXaq



[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40684736/bf614db151e11211e91a243b178d578edfb8761e.png[/img]


[h2]Why a Community Test Build?[/h2]

First off, we think the reader's perception system is going to be a game-changer, and we want to share it with you as soon as possible. This new system also changes how you gain subscribers, impacting the revenue your newspaper generates, which required some rebalancing in the game. We're eager to hear what you all think about it.
Since perception and the new production chain add more complexity to the game, we've added tutorials at different points to explain them. We've tweaked these tutorials internally, but now we want to see how they work for the players, you!

Your feedback during this testing phase will play a crucial role in shaping the final version - so thank you!


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40684736/bf614db151e11211e91a243b178d578edfb8761e.png[/img]

[h2]How do I join the Community Test Build branch on Steam?[/h2]

To access the "Community Test Build" branch, simply follow these steps:

[olist][*]Open the Steam client.
[*]Click on the "Library" tab.
[*]Right-click on "News Tower" and select "Properties".
[*]Click on the "Betas" tab.
[*]In the "Beta participation" field, select "community_test".
[*]Click on the "Close" button.
[*]The game will now be updated to the "community_test" branch.[/olist]
You're in! :)


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40684736/bf614db151e11211e91a243b178d578edfb8761e.png[/img]

[h2]Important information regarding your saves[/h2]

The game should clearly state that your saves are incompatible - however here is what you need to know in case!

[b]You will not be able to:[/b]
[list][*]Continue playing with your old saves in this Community Test Build. It will allow you to access the content of the next update we're working on.
[*]Load a save of the Community Test version into the Live build available on the default branch.[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40684736/bf614db151e11211e91a243b178d578edfb8761e.png[/img]

[h2]KNOWN ISSUE[/h2]

[list][*]To bring the new image production chain to life, we've added a bunch of new news items that include images, illustrations, or maps. We haven't had time to write all of them yet, so you might see some news items with placeholder titles and subtitles. This shows just how fresh our version is![/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40684736/bf614db151e11211e91a243b178d578edfb8761e.png[/img]

[h2]KEY ADDITIONS[/h2]

[h3][b]IMAGE PRODUCTION CHAIN[/b][/h3]

[list][*]Photographer - Can add a picture to news item (Gold tag)

[list][*]Photographer desk - This is where the photographer sits when it’s not assigned to a news item. Similar to how reporter desks work.
[*]Darkroom - Unique to photographs. When the photographer comes back from a news item, he/she develops the negatives into a “real” photograph. The darkroom can not be under a regular light. There is a red development light available as a buff item.
[*]Repro Camera - “Scans” the photo into a format that can be used by the engraver for creating the printable image.
[*]Engraver - Makes a printable “mold” of the image. After this step the graphic is ready to be assembled.
[*]Assembler - As with any item that can be placed in the newspaper, the final step is the assembler.[/list][/list]
[list][*]Cartographer - Can add a map to news item (Silver tag)

[list][*]Cartographer desk - This is where the cartographer sits when it’s not assigned to a news item. Similar to how reporter desks work.
[*]The cartographer chain is similar to the photo chain, except that it does need to go into the darkroom.[/list][/list]
[list][*]Illustrator - Can add an illustration to ads (extra money)

[list][*]Illustrator desk - This is where the illustrator sits when it’s not assigned to a news item. Similar to how reporter desks work.
[*]The illustrator chain is similar to the photo chain, except that it does need to go into the darkroom.[/list][/list]

[b]NEW (BUFF) OBJECTS:[/b]
	
[list][*] Photographer desk: Camera Cabinet, Camera Cleaning Kit, Camera Tripod
[*] Darkroom Technician: Chemicals Cabinet, Development Light, Dry Mount Press, Blackout Curtains
[*] Repro Camera / Photoprocessor: Sharpness Chart, Wet Plate Rack, Blackout Curtains
[*] Engraver: Drying Oven, Engraving Equipment, White Coat Rack
[*] Illustrator: Desk Pencils, Paint Can Cabinet, Painting Easel
[*] Cartographer: Drafting Triangles, Map Cabinet, Telescope, World Map
[*] Sweeping: Sweeping Tools, Big Trash Can (already existed but now buffs sweeping)
[*] Editor: Dictionary Books, File Cabinet, Issue Board, Paper Cutter[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40684736/f17fb7887a81a54a9206921d60ff3d0e614a3f55.png[/img]

[h3][b]READERS' PERCEPTION[/b][/h3]

We are introducing a new mechanic called “Perception”. It’s about how your readers perceive your newspaper. You can be a “Sensational” newspaper, focusing more on fast, tabloid style news. Or an “Informational” newspaper, with more in depth coverage. The middle ground is also possible and it’s called “Moderate”.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40684736/b85f19c039a72d422b219ae4eabfadf25d44c8a7.png[/img]

We are laying a foundation to build upon in future updates, where perception will play a big role in long term planning, rivaling newspapers and other interesting mechanics.
With this update, its main focus is gathering subscribers.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40684736/f17fb7887a81a54a9206921d60ff3d0e614a3f55.png[/img]


Some of the tags that you will encounter have a “Perception side” associated with them. For example, the “Gossip” tag, skews your perception towards Sensational.

When you assemble your newspaper, the total perception value gets summed for the articles, and that determines the character of your newspaper.

Every week, the public perception gets nudged towards the character of your latest print. This moves rather slowly, simulating the real world where public perception doesn’t change overnight.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40684736/73812daed75b0ddefdd726927330d081797a2415.png[/img]

A big change that comes with this new mechanic is that the subscribers you gather from completing districts are no longer subscribers directly. Instead, they become “Potential” subscribers. They have gotten to know your newspaper based on the character of your latest edition. In order for them to subscribe, you have to be consistent in your newspaper’s character. The potential subscribers remember the character of your newspaper, and if you stay consistent, they will become subscribers after a couple of weeks.

Every perception “side” (Sensational, Moderate, Informational) has a distinct set of negative tags associated with them. For example, if the perception of your newspaper is Sensational, readers may find certain stories boring. With this update, you will probably not notice this as the content that utilizes this is still a work in progress.

Reader's Perception gets introduced and unlocked after you’ve completed 12 districts on the N.Y.C. map. Before it is unlocked, the subscriber system works the same as before.

Again, this update is laying the foundation of this mechanic. Expect more in-depth and interesting mechanics using the perception system in future updates.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40684736/f17fb7887a81a54a9206921d60ff3d0e614a3f55.png[/img]

[h3][b]1933[/b][/h3]

For the Community Test version, the content of this news is still placeholder content.
For the full release, the news will utilize a mix of events that truly happened in 1933 and some fake events we created to give additional content.
The new content also uses the new graphic chain items like photographs, illustrations and maps.

[i][b]What about scores then?[/b][/i]

Scores that were made with an older version of News Tower aren’t valid anymore. We’ve added so much new content that it doesn’t make sense to compare old scores with the new ones.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40684736/bf614db151e11211e91a243b178d578edfb8761e.png[/img]

[h2]SMALLER ADDITIONS[/h2]

[h3][b]AD BOYCOTT[/b][/h3]
 
You’ve printed something controversial and the ad companies aren’t too happy with that.
You will be punished and get only partial, or no ad deals at all!

[h3][b]AD QUALITY SYSTEM[/b][/h3]

With the addition of the illustrator, you can now make higher quality ads that contain illustrations. An illustrated ad is unlocked if you hit the top tier (8) in a given category.

[h3][b]AREA MAP LEGEND[/b][/h3]

Visible from january 1930, the area map legend helps you navigate the map. It shows you where all of the upgrades in a given category can be found.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40684736/bf614db151e11211e91a243b178d578edfb8761e.png[/img]
 
 
[h2]IMPROVEMENTS & CHANGES[/h2]
 
[h3][b]EDITOR[/b][/h3]
[list][*]Text (copy) editor and graphic editor remove all pre-production nags. 
[list][*]The editor was undercooked in previous versions. With this update, the editor removes all negative tags from an item. (Except for sloppy production and old news, because this can happen after the editor by for example a sloppy typesetter).
[*]Negative tags now have a larger sales penalty, so in most cases it makes sense to edit those negative tags out. This is of course at the cost of longer production times…
[*]You have to manually enable the editor in the reporting menu itself. It will appear as a checkbox beneath the story file.
[*]Enabling the editor later is also possible via the right drawer. Click on the small diamond that represents the editor to toggle it on and off. Note that once the item has passed the editing stage, it is not possible to toggle it anymore.
[*]Editor can be enabled directly on the story file (if applicable). Default is OFF for now.[/list][/list]
[h3][b]MISCELLANEOUS[/b][/h3]
[list][*]Added numerous new sound effects and ambience sounds.
[*]Newspaper x3 and x2 slots instead of only the above the fold
[*]Toggle all notifications at once can be done with N by default[/list]
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40684736/bf614db151e11211e91a243b178d578edfb8761e.png[/img]
 
[h2]BUG FIXES[/h2]
[list][*]Fixed tower score recording ad revenue and newspaper sales profit a week behind
[*]Fixed employees picking an occupied side at the coffee machine
[*]Chain bubble log overhauled where it's now a separate root like Rush Mode brains and no longer interferes with employee logs
[*]Various minor fixes[/list]
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40684736/bf614db151e11211e91a243b178d578edfb8761e.png[/img]
 
[h2]NEWSBEARERS, ASSEMBLE[/h2]
 
Join the community and talk with team, other players, and share your feedback anytime you want!
 
💌 Come to our [url=https://discord.gg/7gbjjvFcpm]Discord[/url]
✅ Follow us on [url=https://twitter.com/NewsTowerGame]Twitter[/url]
 
Take care of yourself and of each other, newsbearers!

A special thanks to all of you who participated in the test and sent us precious feedback that allowed us to release it for everyone this fast.

Please note, this new mode features randomized news items and lacks the score tracking and historical precision of the main game! 
Although the gameplay balance in Endless Mode may shift, know that we are diligently improving the quality of this game mode during Early Access. 

Below a list of all additions, improvements and fixes added to the main branch following this week of beta testing on the preview build.
Many of these elements were already implemented in the preview build and are simply now being put on the main branch - some others are newly added!


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40684736/f17fb7887a81a54a9206921d60ff3d0e614a3f55.png[/img]

[h2]ADDITIONS[/h2]
 
[h3][b]End of run recap screen[/b][/h3]
[list][*]After you print your December 1932 issue, a new screen will recap your newspaper’s achievements. It shows data such as your record sales numbers, your staff levels or even how many districts you unlocked.
[*]While this screen appears even though you complete a run started on a previous version, some data will be missing (perfect district unlocks, tags colours).
[*]For the time being, this screen is only shown once, and the game doesn’t allow you to review it after the end of your run. We are working on a solution for this. In the meantime, make sure you grab a screenshot if you want to show it around![/list]
[h3][b]Endless Mode Preview Build[/b][/h3]
[list][*]After that recap screen, you will have the option to return to the main menu or to continue playing the game in 'Endless Mode'.
[*]The 'Endless Mode' allows you to continue conquering NYC and developing your tower without any time constraint or limit. 
[*]Please note that 'Breaking News' are not implemented in the that game mode. News items that you will report on in this mode may also be historically inaccurate and more generic.[/list]
[h3][b]Printer[/b][/h3]
[list][*]Added a 5th printer module that can be purchased at the Industry City Harbor for 64 Influence points.[/list]
[h3][b]Tutorial Hints[/b][/h3]
[list][*]Added a tutorial hint that explains items prioritisation in the Article Drawer.
[*]Added a tutorial hint that explains comfort items diminishing returns (e.g. multiple clocks are not the best way to improve comfort).[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40684736/f17fb7887a81a54a9206921d60ff3d0e614a3f55.png[/img]
 
[h2]IMPROVEMENTS[/h2]

[h3][b]Elevator[/b][/h3]
[list][*]The operation of the elevator has been significantly improved. 
[*]It will alternate up and down and pick everybody up along the way. It will let people out on the floors they want to go to.

[i][b]Explanation:[/b][/i]
Imagine there are elevator doors on floors 1 through 4. If there are three reporters waiting on floor 1, each destined for floors 2, 3, and 4 respectively, the elevator will now efficiently pick them up in sequence, stopping at each designated floor in order.

Previously, the elevator would have gone directly all the way up to floor 4, causing delays for passengers bound for intermediate floors. For instance, an employee wanting to go to floor 2 would have experienced a significant wait before reaching their floor.

This issue was also exacerbated when additional passengers joined the journey, further prolonging the travel time for everyone.[/list]
[h3][b]Production chain[/b][/h3]
[list][*]We've enhanced the process for managing the "skipping" of the copy editor or re-inserting it into the production chain (via a simple click on the square on the article card in the drawer). In the previous and current version alike, you can remove the copy editor from the chain if it’s still on its way to the typesetter. However, previously, if you accidentally removed the copy editor, there was no way to reinsert it. With our latest update, you now have the flexibility to both remove and reinsert the copy editor as needed.[/list] 
[h3][b]Miscellaneous [/b][/h3]
[list][*]Severe AI improvement for chain items! Walking time is now taken into account. Should cause much more logical decisions.

[i][b]Explanation:[/b][/i]
It turns out that our AI wasn't factoring in travel time between workstations when deciding where to go. Instead, it was only considering the "level" of the stations and how many items were already being processed there.

This oversight sometimes led to the AI making illogical moves, wasting precious time in the process. But fear not! We've implemented a fix to address this issue. Now, the AI takes travel time into account when determining its path between workstations.

This fix should result in smoother and more efficient AI behavior, making your gameplay experience even better.

[*]Taxis now honk when dropping off reporters coming back to the building.
[*]Manually dropping items in storage slots no longer adjusts the camera view to encompass the whole inventory, making it easier to quickly manually drag items without the camera changing.

notes.title: Hotfix v0.11.136.r
notes.content:
[h3]Hi again newsbearers![/h3]

Here is a quick hotfix to address 2 bugs that stemmed from this morning's update!


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40684736/f17fb7887a81a54a9206921d60ff3d0e614a3f55.png[/img] 

[h2]Bug 1[/h2]
It happens if you have 2 page modules connected with a belt:
[list][*]Stash the left one
[*]Place back a corner or a page module on the left side and reconnect
[*]Now move the page module on the right to another floor, causing the link to break[/list]
What happens is that the "stash" is passed on to objects that are connected. If they then get removed, they will "stash" instead of a regular remove. 

[h2]Fix 1[/h2]
The fix now is that this flag gets cleared after a build action (which is what must happen!).


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40684736/f17fb7887a81a54a9206921d60ff3d0e614a3f55.png[/img] 
 
[h2]Bug 2[/h2]
The 'invalid build object save game' issue had to with the printer belt's collider that became larger with the earlier update we implemented. Consequently, air vents positioned partially behind it were now registering collisions with the printer belt. This adjustment affected many of you who constructed their towers this way.
 
[h2]Fix 2[/h2]
A quick fix has been implemented: collision checking is now disabled when loading a game. 
This adjustment poses no issue as the objects were initially placed without conflict, ensuring that they remain valid unless moved.

notes.title: Our very first update!!! THE STASH UPDATE IS FRESH OUT OF THE PRINTER!
notes.content:
[h3]Good day dear newsbearers![/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40684736/2bbebf9bce1a16bf9f68bbf234e5b3eb6a718e89.png[/img]

[b]Attention, attention! Update approaching! [/b]
But before we hit you with the good stuff, let's take a moment to appreciate [b]YOU[/b]! 
Your joy, engagement, and feedback have been absolutely instrumental in shaping the game's development and this update. We appreciate you all! [b]THANK YOU, NEWSBEARERS. [/b]

We’ve been hard at work on many improvements, fixes, and one particular feature that will ease your life as builders!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40684736/f17fb7887a81a54a9206921d60ff3d0e614a3f55.png[/img]

[h2]BUILD STASH[/h2]

You can now store objects in the “stash” - this will allow you to change around your floors setup more easily!
[list]
[*]Implemented the build stash function, enabling players to temporarily stash objects and return them to the tower without any cost. Stashed items can be found at the bottom of the build menu. 
[*]Introduced the build multi-stash function: the stash tab on the build drawer now features a button that allows users to stash the selected items (up to 10 items at a time).[/list]

Here is a quick video to see this new feature in action!

[previewyoutube=no-_l2qiLr8;full][/previewyoutube]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40684736/f17fb7887a81a54a9206921d60ff3d0e614a3f55.png[/img]
 
[h2]ADDITIONS[/h2]

[h3][b]Tutorials[/b][/h3]
[list][*]Added new tutor tips at first print, explaining the player can still produce during Sunday, and that game time automatically stops before the end of Sunday, for a “Last Chance To Print”. 
[*]Added new tutor tips to the article in production tutorial, explaining how to manually edit articles by discarding parts of a story that are either unfinished or cannot be printed due to requirements. 
[*]Added a new tutorial hinting towards expanding the workforce after placing the nth-page module. Currently only on the 3rd page, with monitoring from week 4 onward.[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40684736/f17fb7887a81a54a9206921d60ff3d0e614a3f55.png[/img] 

[h2]IMPROVEMENTS[/h2]

[h3][b]Comfort[/b][/h3]
[list][*]Discomfort logs of employees now record when their discomfort decreases while it is low, rather than whenever its value is low. 
[*]Removed redundant entries in employees’ comfort logs. 
[*]Improved the distribution of comfort levels.[/list]
[h3][b]Bribes[/b][/h3]
[list][*]Bribe minigames can now be cancelled after starting them. The player loses no money, and the path remains open to try again later. 
[*]Improved scaling of big steps for bribe minigames.[/list]
[h3][b]Build items[/b][/h3] 
[list][*]The acoustic Panel now follows similar cropping as other wall objects, taking up 1 cell less space overall in both dimensions and allowing placement above printer belts.
[*]Small items (currently only the small plant) can be placed on the edges of the printer input, page and output. 
[*]The assembly table supports 2 small trash cans underneath it.[/list]
[h3][b]User interface [/b][/h3]
[list][*]Trash spawns a little less for Production desks and the Generator.
[*]Fixed monthly expense recap page "Decreased by" percent calculation to actually show correct percentage. Additionally, it now highlights the decrease in green text if monthly expenses actually decreased.
[*]Resource order buttons now display the total in tower + the ordered supply in their tooltips.
[*]The hourglass icon in the article drawer (indicating an almost expired article) is larger.
[*]Dragging an item from an article onto a copy editing desk is now only allowed if that item contains the “Sloppy Reporting” nag.
[*]Drawers now close on mouse up instead of mouse down. Allowing for starting a multi-select with the build drawer open.[/list]
[h3][b]Controls[/b][/h3] 
[list][*]Fast forward now jumps back to pause when engaged during manual pause.
[*]Moving a printer corner that already exists now plays the same sound as building a new one.[/list]
[h3][b]Employees[/b][/h3] 
[list][*]Security will return to idle quicker if there is no more work to do. Previously, they would await until everybody had left.[/list]
[h3][b]Printing[/b][/h3] 
[list][*]“Above the fold” now also doubles influence points.
[*]The “Above the fold” display now includes a breakdown of what is multiplied if there are multiple stats being multiplied.[/list]
[h3][b]Save games[/b][/h3] 
[list][*]Game checks for save files compatibility; save games from the demo versions (0.9.2 and 0.9.3) are not compatible with version 0.11.132. 
[*]Auto-save entries are now below the games they belong to.[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40684736/f17fb7887a81a54a9206921d60ff3d0e614a3f55.png[/img]

[h2]FIXES[/h2]
[list][*]Fixed load game “invalid object” error due to the fact you could place a printer belt vertically over a small lamp. 
[*]Purged all input control schemes except for Keyboard & Mouse and Gamepads, which is a probable fix for constant device switching for players with a connected Joystick device. 
[*]Fixed resolutions on Mac; game settings now offer a broader range of resolutions.
[*]Fixed newsbook tutor tips not properly handling paused state, causing the newsbook to possibly close due to completed tutorial story file before everything was explained.
[*]Fixed wall and ceiling signs not updating text before placing them down.
[*]Fixed "New actions possible" blue folder on globe points being rotated arbitrarily.
[*]Fixed view mode shortcuts still triggering while typing text into input fields (e.g. wall signs, employee renaming).
[*]Fixed article drawer status labels sometimes displaying an incorrect icon.

notes.title: NEWS TOWER DEMO IS OUT NOW!
notes.content:
[h3][b]Welcome and a good day to you, dearest publishers & future media mavens![/b][/h3]

We are [i][b]THRILLED[/b][/i] to unveil our News Tower demo, now available as part of the Steam Economy and Capitalism fest! 

To be a successful media mogul, master the printing process.
Remember, [b]there is one rule[/b]: print every Sunday and beat the Sunday deadline with more articles.
Get more revenue by delivering more articles with impressive combos and extensively researched content. Increased earnings will pave the way for a higher Tower and expanded article coverage... And more money!
Well, you get the idea, right? 😎

Keep in mind that our demo is a work in progress for what News Tower Early Access will look like!


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40684736/f17fb7887a81a54a9206921d60ff3d0e614a3f55.png[/img]


[h2]📰 DEMO CONTENT[/h2]

In the News Tower demo, you can experience the [b]full tutorial[/b] as well as [b]6 months of publishing newspapers[/b], up until July 1930 - with limited access to buff items, shops, and storylines. 

To become a successful publisher in a short time, you'll need to optimize your production as much as possible!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40684736/e0958c0772c64e0d7954fda7bf851f2168be99a1.png[/img]

[h3][b]Here are a few tips on how to play the demo the best way![/b][/h3]

[h3]Focus on Crime and Sports[/h3]
The demo allows you to unlock 6 districts in Brooklyn and 3 in Queens, whose readership is particularly interested in juicy crime reports and fascinating sports news. 
By focusing your reporters on these news items, you will help them gain experience and work faster!

[h3]Dismiss news that don’t fit your needs[/h3]
On the news map, you can dismiss news items that aren't relevant to your publishing goals for the week. This will free up your news searcher's line of communication!


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40684736/f17fb7887a81a54a9206921d60ff3d0e614a3f55.png[/img]


[h2]🗽 HOW TO PLAY THE DEMO[/h2]

[h3]Go on our store page below and click on the "Download" button as showcased under! As simple as that![/h3]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1649950/News_Tower/

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40684736/96a081338d70c4d03c50acf3dc9c032ab4db9b81.png[/img]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40684736/f17fb7887a81a54a9206921d60ff3d0e614a3f55.png[/img]

[h3][b]Will my progress carry over when I buy the full game?[/b][/h3]

The demo build is still a work in progress, our goal being to gather your feedback and keep improving News Tower to eventually create the best possible version of the game. Before the full release, we will keep on implementing changes, meaning that, unfortunately, your progress will not be carried over.

*****************

[h3][b]When can I play the demo? [/b][/h3]

You can play the News Tower demo from January 8th 10AM Pacific time until January 15th 10 AM Pacific time!

*****************

[h3][b]What has changed since News Tower Closed Beta?[/b][/h3]

We’d like to thank once again all our Closed Beta players whose feedback has been very valuable!

[b]Progression and unlocking reworked:[/b]
[list][*] You can now unlock districts even if you haven’t met all the necessary tags but you will get less subscribers.[/list][b]Shop distribution reworked:[/b]
[list][*] You can now have access faster to the much needed security items to protect your tower from mobsters and protesters.[/list][b]Mafia mission reworked: [/b]

*****************

[h3][b]In what languages is News Tower available?[/b][/h3]

News Tower is currently available only in English in his Early Access phase. We appreciate your understanding as we focus on refining the game! More languages will surely come along at a later point.

*****************

[h3][b]Will there be ongoing improvements and updates during Early Access?[/b][/h3]

Absolutely! We're committed to enhancing News Tower continuously during the Early Access based on your valuable feedback. Your input will play a crucial role in shaping the game's development!



[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40684736/f17fb7887a81a54a9206921d60ff3d0e614a3f55.png[/img]

notes.title: Happy New Year From News Tower HQ!
notes.content:
News Tower HQ wishes all of you a happy new year!

2022 will be an exciting year for us. Since the October Edition of Next Fest 2021, we have been working hard on new features, bug fixes and AI improvement to deliver the Early Access version of ‘News Tower’ to Steam this year. (New) features which we have been working on include:

- Totally revamped the way you report on news offering more depth and gameplay.
- You can now choose a direction of your newspaper and work your way towards targets which apply to this direction to satisfy and reach your readers.
- No more hard requirements on news. You can only do better.
- News items now have categories and a quality mark which play an important role in reaching your audience targets.
- A different and more simple mechanic for ads.
- News can now have ‘risks’ attached to it like lawsuits or injury points for your employees which adds more depth to the choices you make.
- Added an overview screen of all your employees
- Employees now have traits giving them unique characteristics which can be useful in many aspects of the game.
- Added category bonuses: you earn more points by placing similar categories on the same page of your newspaper.
- Enhanced hints for placing buff objects. Preview areas where placing accessories makes sense.
- Skill/Leveling system for employees actually works now.
- Search the globe more efficiently using filters for category or news quality.
- A working kitchen with a cook.
- Shared waiting lines for toilets and coffee machines.
- Employees take elevators based on congestion, not randomly.

Also improved the general AI, have been working on further game performance optimizations and (obviously) lots of little bug fixes.

We’re very excited for what’s to come this year and about all improvements and features. We hope you are as well and are looking forward to sharing the EA release of News Tower with all of you.

Stay tuned.

News Tower HQ

notes.title: News Tower Demo Released During Steam Next Fest – October Edition 2021
notes.content:
[b]News Tower Demo Released During Steam Next Fest – October Edition 2021[/b]
We have some exciting news! During the October Edition of Steam Next Fest 2021, we will be releasing the first playable demo of News Tower. The demo will be available within the Steam Store on the 1st of October 2021. This also means that we will participate in the October Edition of Steam Next Fest 2021.

The News Tower Demo will include the following features:
- A full reporting to print chain.
- 6 news categories with different angle options which earns you reputation points.
- Use your reputation points to score advertisement deals for your newspaper.
- Facilitate Editors, Typesetters, Compositors, Illustrators and Cartographers within your tower.
- Manage your team and account for a clear and efficient infrastructure.

We’re really excited for you to try our demo! Also, we are looking forward to hearing all your feedback on our very first demo. All feedback is much appreciated and will help us to improve and deliver the best possible full edition of News Tower. So please do post your feedback on our Steam Community page or connect with us on[b][url=https://discord.com/invite/zXxhFVpnYF/] our Discord server[/url][/b].

[b]News Tower EA Release Delayed[/b]
Following the news of the release of our first demo, we sadly had to postpone our Early Access release. Our first deadline turned out to be too ambitious. For the past few weeks, we’ve worked hard to be able to deliver a playable demo of the game. We’re looking forward to seeing all your first published newspapers.

[b]Next Fest Livestreams (1st & 6th Of October)[/b]
We have also scheduled 2 livestreams during Steam Next Fest. Our first livestream will take place on the 1st of October at 6PM (CEST) and will encompass a full tutorial of the demo. Our second Next Fest livestream will be on Wednesday the 6th of October and will also take place at 6PM (CEST); this will be a live Q&A session with the development team! We look forward to seeing you during one of these livestreams and hope you enjoy our demo. 

Stay tuned!

Best,
The News Tower team
